research: The 3.79% — Ternary Logic at the Boundaries of Knowledge

GODEL.k3: UNKNOWN (0) — neither provably TRUE nor provably FALSE within the system

QUANTUM.k3: UNKNOWN (0) — the outcome is literally undefined before measurement

CHAOS.k3: UNKNOWN (0) — predictable in principle, but only by running the universe itself

QUALIA.k3: UNKNOWN (0) — the experience exists but is incommunicable in propositional form

COSMIC.k3: UNKNOWN (0) — true out there, but forever inaccessible here

GODEL.desc: Mathematical undecidability — no system can prove its own consistency

QUANTUM.desc: Physical randomness — the universe rolls dice at the Planck scale

CHAOS.desc: Computational irreducibility — some answers cost more than the universe

COSMIC.desc: Observational inaccessibility — beyond the cosmic event horizon

insight: The 3.79% IS the truth. Not failure. The boundary of knowledge itself.
